company.name: Center for a New American Security

profile_text.body:
Center for a New American Security is a nonprofit organization founded in 2007 and headquartered in Washington, DC. According to its website, CNAS focuses on developing strong, pragmatic and principled national security and defense policies.

The organization has developed a research focus on artificial intelligence as it relates to national security. CNAS launched the Sovereign AI Index to track every government-backed sovereign AI project since 2023, examining efforts by countries to improve their AI self-reliance. The organization's work has also examined issues around AI model transparency and monitoring, including analysis of how commercial AI systems are identified and trained.
